q: How many products are in the Electronics category?
ref: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category='Electronics'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='cancelled'

q: What is the most expensive product?
ref: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which country has the most customers?
ref: SELECT country FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which product sold the most units (all orders)?
ref: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the total revenue from non-cancelled orders, rounded to 2 decimals?
ref: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status<>'cancelled'

q: How many orders were placed in October 2026?
ref: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2026-10-%'

q: How many customers live in Lisbon?
ref: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city='Lisbon'

q: What is the average product price, rounded to 2 decimals?
Which customer (name) placed the most orders?
ref: SELECT c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many orders are still pending?
ref: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='pending'

q: Which category generated the most revenue from non-cancelled orders?
ref: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status<>'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many products have fewer than 50 units in stock?
ref: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE stock<50
